entities.summary: Mikael Pernfors is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He reached the men's singles final at the French Open in 1986, and won the 1993 Canadian Open in Montreal. Mikael Pernfors was a athletes & competitors from Malmö (b. 1963-07-16, Malmö). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
